summary: Raghunath Damodar Karmarkar (1893–1964) worked in Indology and philosophy. Formerly principal at Sir Parashurambhau College, he served at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute as Director of the Post-Graduate and Research Department (attested 1953) and professor (attested 1966).
Raghunath Giri was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Vamacharana Bhattacharya. He served as department head (科長) at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith and taught Atsushi Uno.
Raghunath Purushottam Paranjpye (1876–1966) studied under Vaman Shivram Apte. He served as Vice-Chancellor of Savitribai Phule Pune University (attested 1959).

Rahul Peter Das (born 1954), an Indologist and linguist, studied at Calcutta, Cologne, and Hamburg under Klaus Ludwig Janert and Albrecht Wezler. He taught and researched at Hamburg, Bonn, and Groningen before becoming Professor at Martin Luther University of Halle-Wittenberg (1994–2020).

Rahul Sankrityayan (1893–1963) worked in Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology. He held a Sanskrit teaching position at Vidyalankara Pirivena (1927) and taught Sanskrit (1937) and held a professorship (1945–1947) at Saint Petersburg State University.

Raimo Anttila (1935–2023) was a scholar of linguistics and Indology. He studied at Yale University under Warren Crawford Cowgill (~1962–1966) and held posts at the University of California, Los Angeles (1965) and the University of Helsinki (1971–1976).

Raimon Panikkar (1918–2010), a scholar of philosophy, religious studies, and Indology, studied under Juan Zaragüeta and earned doctorates at Madrid and Lateran. He was a philosophy professor at Madrid (1946–1953) and taught at Harvard (1967–1971) and UC Santa Barbara (1971–1978).

Raimond Gaita (born 1946) is a philosopher who studied at the University of Melbourne and the University of Leeds. He served as Professor of Moral Philosophy at King's College London (1977–2011) and Foundation Professor of Philosophy at Australian Catholic University (1993–2011).

Rajan Gurukkal (born 1948), a historian and Indologist, studied at the University of Calicut and Jawaharlal Nehru University. He was on the faculty at JNU (~1983–1988) and became Director of the School of Social Sciences at Mahatma Gandhi University (1988).

Rajeev Sangal works in computational linguistics and Indology. He studied at IIT Kanpur and the University of Pennsylvania, and held posts at IIT Kanpur (1982–1998), IIIT Hyderabad (2002–2013, 2018–2022), and IIT (BHU) Varanasi (2013–2018).

Rajendra Chandra Hazra (1904–1982) was an Indologist who earned his B.A. and completed doctoral study under Sushil Kumar De at the University of Dhaka. He taught at Dhaka (1939–1951) and was Associate Professor at Sanskrit College and University (1951–1972).

Rajendra Mishra (born 1943) is an Indologist who studied under Rambhadracharya. He served as head of the Sanskrit department at Himachal Pradesh University and as Vice-Chancellor of Sampurnanand Sanskrit University.

Rajendralal Mitra (1824–1891), an Indologist, historian, and Buddhist studies scholar, studied at Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata, and the University of Calcutta. He served as librarian-cum-assistant-secretary (1846–1856) and president (1885) of The Asiatic Society, and directed Wards' Institution (1856–1881).

Rajesh P. N. Rao (born 1970) works in computational fields and Indology. He studied under Dana H. Ballard at the University of Rochester and at Angelo State University. In 2000, he became a professor of computer science at the University of Washington.

Rajkrishna Mukhopadhyay (1845–1886) was a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied at Krishnagar Government College and Presidency University (~1864–1868), later holding posts at Scottish Church College and Presidency University (~1875–1880).

Rakhal Das Banerji (1885–1930) was an Indologist and historian educated at Presidency University and the University of Calcutta. He served as an officer with the Archaeological Survey of India (1911–1926) and held a professorship at Banaras Hindu University (1928–1930).
Rakra Tethong Rinpoche studied under Gendün Chöphel and Trijang Rinpoche.

Ralf Kramer (born 1971), a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies, studied at the University of Hamburg under David P. Jackson and at the University of London. He became Aris Librarian for Tibetan & Himalayan Studies at the Bodleian Library.

Ralph Abraham (1936–2024) was a scholar of philosophy and other fields who studied at the University of Michigan and under Debabrata SenSharma. He held posts at Berkeley, Columbia, and Princeton before joining UC Santa Cruz as professor (1968, 1980).
Ralph Lerner (born 1928) is a philosopher who studied at the University of Chicago (~1945–1953) under Leo Strauss (~1947–1953). He held a post at the University of Chicago from around 1953 to 2003.
